stories.title: Dick's Sporting Goods shares drop 30% as footwear demand slumps, dragging other shoe stocks
stories.summary: Dick's Sporting Goods stock fell about 30% after the retailer missed expectations and cited a "challenging" footwear market. The company pointed to shoppers souring on retro sneaker styles, and the drop pulled down shares of other footwear giants.
stories.whyItMatters: A steep miss from a major sporting goods retailer signals softening consumer demand in footwear, a category other retailers and brands depend on.
whatToWatch: Reaction from other footwear and sneaker-brand stocks
questions: Which specific footwear giants were hit and by how much?

stories.title: Asian currencies mixed ahead of US PCE data; Aussie dollar climbs on hot CPI
stories.summary: Asian currencies traded mixed as investors await the US PCE inflation report, the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge. The Australian dollar rose after domestic CPI data came in hotter than expected.
stories.whyItMatters: The PCE print will shape expectations for the Fed's next rate move, while the CPI-driven Aussie gain points to similar inflation pressure facing the RBA.
whatToWatch: Any RBA commentary responding to the hot CPI reading
questions: Will the PCE data confirm or contradict the inflation signal from Australia's CPI?
